messages.content: Hey, it's your Northline Care weekly check-in. Hope the week's treating you alright. Do you have a blood pressure reading from today or yesterday you can share with me?
141 over 88, took it about an hour ago
Thanks, I've logged that for your care team. Any issues with your medications this week — anything running low or missed doses?
Nope all good on that front. Wish you could help me sort out my insurance thing though

I hear you — I'm not able to help with insurance, that's outside what I can do right now. For that you'd need to reach your insurer directly or your clinic's billing office. I'll get your next check-in scheduled for this time next week.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
